newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan vegoil rates seen down on local supply.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan vegoil rates seen down on local supply.

text.p: Pakistani vegetable oil rates were likely to drop further next week due to the arrival of local supplies and the downward trend was likely to continue in the coming months, dealers said on Friday.
"Vegoil oil rates in the domestic market will slip further on the arrival of local supplies (which is) due to start in the next few days and on increased imports," dealer Saulat Khan said.
Three ships with around 36,000 tonnes of soyoil were due this month.
This week RBD palm oil rates fell to $560 per tonne C&F from $565 and soyoil to $550 from $555, a Saulat Enterprise dealer said.
Vegoil stocks rose to 180,000 tonnes, including 140,000 tonnes of RBD palm oil and olein, from 161,000 last week due to higher imports.
The Ghee Corporation of Pakistan (GCP) had 7,000 tonnes of palm oil and olein for sale in April.
